title: Spec Review Feedback (v1)
description: Structured payload embedded in a single PR comment produced by the Spec Navigator. The PR comment body contains (a) a trigger line, (b) a fenced code block tagged `json spec-review-feedback-v1` whose contents validate against this schema, and (c) a human-readable rendering of the same data. The rendering is derived from this object at POST time. Per reviewer decision 7C, the comment shape is unified across drafting and submission — draft-only timestamp fields (`createdAt`, `updatedAt`) are accepted as optional and simply carried through; the reader ignores them.

schemaVersion.description: Literal version tag. MUST match the fenced-block language tag used in the PR-comment body.

pr.description: Pull-request number in the target repository.

originalHeadSha.description: Full SHA-1 of the pull request's head commit at the moment the reviewer loaded the navigator. Every artefact the reviewer read was fetched pinned to this SHA.

submittedAtHeadSha.description: Full SHA-1 of the pull request's head commit at the moment Submit was posted. When equal to originalHeadSha the PR was stable across the review session. When different, the PR was force-pushed (or otherwise re-pointed) between load and submit, and the reviewer acknowledged the stale-head modal before proceeding.

submittedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp set at POST time.

comments.description: One or more comments. An empty submission is not permitted (see FR-027).

CommentTag.description: Closed tag vocabulary (5 values). Matches spec.md FR-015. Each tag must be actionable by the PR watcher.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the target artefact.

snippet.description: Verbatim selected passage. Preserved across drafts and submission; the primary ground truth for relocating the comment.

contextBefore.description: Up to ~60 characters of source immediately before the snippet, trimmed on a word boundary where possible. Empty only when the snippet starts at offset 0.

contextAfter.description: Up to ~60 characters of source immediately after the snippet, trimmed on a word boundary where possible. Empty only when the snippet ends at end-of-file.

anchorHash.description: Pinned format: <first20chars-of-snippet>\x1F<last20chars-of-snippet>\x1F<char-offset-into-raw-source-at-fetch-time>. \x1F is ASCII US (unit separator) — cannot appear in source markdown, so round-tripping is unambiguous.
